scope: Frontend production TS/TSX. Functions unchanged. Same Lens revision, configuration, thresholds, exclusions and whole-project audit scope as baseline.

priorities.change: Separate offline action preparation from local mutation
priorities.value: Validation, child scope and history snapshots resolve before progress changes. enqueue cognitive complexity 28 to 13; preparation is counted separately. Rejected actions preserve projections and sequence.
Calendar, weather and offline sync share timeout/abort cleanup. Weather retries recover even if the transport ignores abort. Late responses cannot replace a retried result.
Animal sessions and checked activities share timer ownership. Reset, mode changes, external completion and unmount cancel stale feedback and prevent duplicate outcome saves.

priorities.change: Native star button and keyboard letter toolbar
priorities.value: Native Space/Enter activation replaces manual keyboard branching. Letter navigation has a single roving Tab stop, arrow-key navigation and an associated accessible description. Existing artwork remains.

Saved exploration, city/date transitions and nightly resets belong to useExplorerSession. Date and clock conversion share syncInstant; rendering remains in useDayNightExplorerModel. Existing integration tests exercise restoration, DST, cancellation of late location fixes and scene synchronization.

validation.browser: 5 Chromium scenarios passed, covering both calendar themes, filters/navigation and concurrent offline replay
validation.lint: npm run lint and all pre-commit ESLint/Prettier hooks passed
validation.focused_tests: Offline/store/recovery/shared progress, deadline/weather/calendar, animal/challenge cancellation, star keyboard activation, letter navigation and Time Explorer reset/weather passed

limitations: Total cognitive complexity is unchanged and total cyclomatic complexity increases by 5. Maximum callable complexity and estimated effort improve.
Production TS/TSX grows by 56 source lines; regression tests add further lines. This pass does not reduce total LOC.
Summed locality risk increases by 168 while module count increases by 3. Leverage risk is unchanged. Shared lifecycle code improves actual reuse but does not lower those aggregate risk scores.
Clone detectors report zero groups before and after. Removed duplication was conceptual, not a detected clone group.
High-risk hotspot records increase from 181 to 184 as responsibilities move. New helpers are counted in project totals.
Six accessibility findings remain: five aria-description compatibility warnings and the native dialog event warning. No accessibility rules were disabled.

Effort is a static estimate, not engineering time. Coverage and runtime performance were not measured. Existing large-chunk build warning remains.
